name: Triumphal Arch
text: Whenever you win a trick your partner led, gain +20 contract value.

signature.trigger: you win a trick your partner led

family: Card-bound points / On win (your partner's tricks)
decision: Which suits your partner should lead into: your strong suits, so your winners take the tricks they open, rather than overtaking them.
opponent: Visible on each trigger; opponents can trump the suits your partner leads.
aiNote: When your partner leads, win with your highest card if it beats the cards already played.
rationale: Your partner leads about three or four tricks a round and you win about one of them, more when your partner leads into your aces, so it pays about +20 to +30, about +20 EV, the uncommon budget. Both seats pull the same way: your partner leads your strong suits, and you win.
deviation: Redesigned from +5 per trick your partner had won, which asked the partner to win early and you to win late.
